job.text: How did gross sales and customer satisfaction change over 2022?

insight.important: Gross sales and average customer satisfaction both rose over the year

title.text: Gross Sales and Customer Satisfaction Both Rose over 2022
title.descriptive: Gross Sales and Average Customer Satisfaction by Month, 2022

source.shows: a merged chart instead of a dual axis: two lines in different units stacked on one time axis, drawn once at the foot, each panel its own scale with its unit phrase on its top label (G2.31, G2.32); the rating's zero is an anchor, so its line need not start at zero (G2.10); both lines in the single-line colour, since the panels already tell them apart (R3-3), where the book keeps the dual axis's orange and blue
the book's dual-axis chart, refused: two variables against two value axes in one plot suggest false crossings and similar volatility (G2.31)
